prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: SaaS服务合同新旧条款对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "条款号" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 2: header "原文" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1563px
  col 3: header "修订后" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 3232px
  col 4: header "修订说明" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 1425px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对照SaaS服务合同的新旧条款及修订说明，帮助读者识别每项合同义务的变化。","reading":"读者先按条款号定位，再横向比较原文与修订后文本，最后阅读修订说明；同一行应作为一个比较单元。","groups":["原文与修订后承担相同的合同正文角色，需要并列比较；修订后内容更长，可适当获得更多宽度。","修订说明与两版正文共同解释同一条款的变化，但属于辅助说明。","条款号是行标识，应保持紧凑并便于纵向扫描。"],"keep_intact":["条款号，如第12.4条","合同中的数字、期限及其他不宜拆开的标识"],"may_wrap":["原文和修订后的中文合同正文可自然换行","修订说明可自然换行；正文较长的行通常可以吸收说明列的换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [83, 205, 280, 151] · table 720×1497px · row heights [36, 246, 269, 315, 339, 292] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [83, 195, 275, 166] · table 720×1474px · row heights [36, 246, 246, 315, 339, 292] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [83, 190, 295, 151] · table 720×1428px · row heights [36, 246, 269, 292, 315, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"条款号完整且便于纵向定位；原文与修订后并列，表头清楚，正文和说明都没有单词被拆开。","problems":"修订后在第7.2、9.1和12.4条中形成很高的文字块，原文下方留下大面积空白；说明列也较窄，换行频繁。","cause":"修订后为280px，尚不足以舒展长条款；说明列151px，正文只有约130px可用宽度。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"说明列较宽，解释文字更易连续阅读；第5.3条的正文与说明高度较接近，行内空间利用较好。","problems":"原文比r1A更窄，部分语句被切成较短行；修订后仍形成很高的文字块，尤其是第9.1条，拉大了原文下方空白。","cause":"说明列增至166px，占用了原文和修订后的空间；两列分别只有195px和275px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"修订后获得更多宽度，第7.2、9.1和12.4条的文字块明显缩短；条款号完整，表头未换行，整表仍在视口内。","problems":"第5.3条的说明比修订后更早后结束的问题相反：说明比修订后更长，决定了行高；原文列较窄，第3.1条原文换行较多。第9.1和12.4条原文下方仍有较大空白。","cause":"修订后增至295px，而说明只有151px、原文只有190px；各行新旧条款长度差异也会造成空白。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"C-balanced","widths":[83,190,285,161],"change":"从r1C的修订后列移10px给说明列，检验第5.3条说明能否缩短，同时保留修订后较宽的阅读空间。"},{"name":"C-original","widths":[83,200,285,151],"change":"从r1C的修订后列移10px给原文，改善两版正文并列阅读，观察修订后较长条款是否因此增加过多换行。"},{"name":"compact-id","widths":[78,190,300,151],"change":"将条款号列收窄5px并交给修订后列；该列仍有57px文字宽度，检验最长条款号能否完整显示，以及长条款的行高是否进一步改善。"}]}
